name: agent-voice-bridge
description: Universal VS Code / Antigravity / Cursor / Windsurf voice-to-agent extension. Speak to your AI coding agent via microphone with Gemini 2.5 Flash, OpenRouter, or Whisper.

commands.title: Agent Voice: Toggle Recording (Talk to Agent)
Agent Voice: Open Voice Controller Panel
Agent Voice: Re-inject Last Transcript into Chat

agentVoice.provider.description: Transcription provider: 'gemini' (Gemini 2.5 Flash), 'openrouter' (OpenRouter audio model), 'openai' (Whisper API), or 'browser' (Web Speech API).

agentVoice.captureMode.description: Microphone capture backend: 'auto' uses native Windows MCI recorder on Windows (avoids IDE webview permission blocks) and webview elsewhere.

agentVoice.geminiApiKey.description: Gemini API key. If empty, auto-reads GEMINI_API_KEY from environment, workspace .env, or e:\apache\.env.

agentVoice.openrouterApiKey.description: OpenRouter API key (used when provider is 'openrouter'). If empty, auto-reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY from environment or .env.

agentVoice.openrouterModel.description: OpenRouter model ID supporting audio input (used when provider is 'openrouter').

agentVoice.openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key (used only when provider is set to 'openai'). If empty, auto-reads OPENAI_API_KEY from environment or .env.

agentVoice.autoSubmit.description: Automatically submit the chat prompt after injecting the transcribed text.

agentVoice.cleanTranscript.description: Instruct Gemini to remove filler words (um, uh) and false starts while keeping technical terms exact.

agentVoice.customVocabulary.default: XAUUSDm, US30m, USOILm, BTCUSDm, MQL5, ATR, scalper, walk-forward, Antigravity
agentVoice.customVocabulary.description: Comma-separated domain terms to help Gemini transcribe specialized vocabulary accurately.

agentVoice.preserveClipboard.description: Restore previous clipboard contents shortly after pasting into Agent Chat.
